findings.detail: bvn length: handler enforces exactly 10 characters, spec requires minLength 11 / maxLength 11
findings.evidence: handlers/misc.go:25 `if len(req.BVN) != 10 {` rejects any BVN that is not exactly 10 characters, so an 11-character BVN — valid under the spec's minLength 11/maxLength 11 — is rejected with 400 invalid_bvn. (The accompanying message "bvn must be 11 digits" contradicts the check itself, confirming the bound enforced is 10, not 11.) — verified: value for "bvn" satisfies the documented constraint, but the handler returned 400: {"success":false,"code":"invalid_bvn","message":"bvn must be 11 digits"}
